name: Create Trap, Lesser
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level inquisitor 1, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, F (small piece of machinery)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect one trap; see text
Duration 1 day
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You toss the piece of machinery and a trap appears where the part lands. You create any CR 1 trap in a 5-foot-by-5-foot triggering square within the range of the spell. The trap created is active and ready to be sprung.

If the trap is sprung, or the duration expires, the trap disintegrates to dust and the piece of machinery used as the material component is left behind.

Create Trap

School conjuration (creation); Level inquisitor 3, ranger 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

This spell functions as lesser create trap except you create one CR 2 trap with up to a 10-foot-by-5-foot triggering area, or two CR 1 traps with their own 5-foot-by-5-foot triggering area.

Create Trap, Greater

School conjuration (creation); Level inquisitor 5, ranger 4, sorcerer/wizard 5

This spell functions as lesser create trap except you create one CR 4 trap with up to a 10-foot-by-10-foot triggering area, or two CR 2 traps with up to a 10-foot-by-5-foot triggering area.
